minutes_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  August 24, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 2814 Concord Avenue

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the illegal driveway
gate shall be removed.

The applicant: Kenneth Rojas was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

The applicant had no questions.

Tsai stated that there was no roof plan. He questioned if the porch was to remain and the applicant
confirmed it was. He also asked if the window complied with egress. The applicant stated that he
understood that it was compliant due to the fact that it was a casement (the notation on the plan was
that it was a single hung which caused the confusion).

Hernandez was accepting of the change. She questioned if the material was to be stucco and the
applicant confirmed that it was. She recommended updating the drawings to reflect the accurate
intention of the casement.

Udani questioned where the roof skylight was located. The applicant stated it was in the laundry
room. He concurred with the other board members.

MOTION:
 •  Stanley Tsai moved to approve the application with the conditions: 1) the front window
  shall be accurately represented as a casement window and; 2) the illegal driveway gate
  shall be removed.

  1
   •  The second was by Nora Hernnadez
  •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 415 East San Marino Avenue

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1. The
vertical wood siding detail below the gable ends shall occur at all gables; 2. Posts shall be provided
at the second floor rear cantilever condition; and 3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and
approved by DRB staff during the building plan check.

The applicant: Sam Zhou was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Zhou questioned the conditions as suggested by staff but was accepting of the conditions of
approval.

Tsai questioned the graphics on the site plan. He clarified that the cantilever of the second floor was
the 6-6” dimension. Tsai agreed that the posts are needed but do not need to be flush with the edge
of the second floor. He also stated that the vertical siding should be at all gables.

Hernandez stated that had no issues with the siding. She is more considered with the massing of the
rear second story but since it is not highly visible from the street is is acceptable.

Udani concurred with the two issues discussed. Having two or more posts are recommended but can
be recessed from the edge

Hernandez stated that the front porch posts should be increased in size to be more proportional to
the rest of the house. The other Board members concurred.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The
  vertical wood siding detail below the gable ends shall occur at all gables; 2. Posts shall be
  provided at the second floor rear cantilever condition; 3. Posts at the front porch shall be
  increased in size to be more proportionate with the house and; 4. All revised drawings shall
  be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to building plan check.
 •  The second was by Stanley Tsai
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  2
 ITEM 3:
APPLICANT: 205 & 207 South Marguerita Avenue

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO compliant
landscape documents shall be provided during the building plan check.

The applicant: Feng Xiao was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Tsai questioned the height of the building and the eave overhang dimension.

The applicant stated that the floor heights are consistent and that the steps up to the second floor in
a Spanish Revival detail. The overhang is 2’0. Likewise the asymmetrical detailing was purposeful
and consistent with the architectural style.

Hernandez appreciated the detail of the shutters and the windows. The applicant described the detail
of the accent windows.

Udani questioned the colors of the shutters. The applicant stated that the shutter color was part of
the diversity of the design which gives a distinction between the left and right buildings. The
applicant did state that the color green is too saturated on the rendering.

Discussion ensued regarding the Benjamin Moore color palette which is darker and more subdued.
The Board concurred that the color was acceptable.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1) That
  the green color be specified as discussed and the documents be updated and; 2) MWELO
  compliant landscape documents shall be provided during building plan check.
 •  The second was by Stanley Tsai.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:15
 •  Seconded by Ankit Udani.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

  3
 Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
